result.detail:
I did not run any tool, and I report no coverage figures. [run:run-0001] is the earlier idle-testbench simulation, cited only as the baseline; it is not a run of this testbench.

Design choice for review: the N=32 instance adds coverage points of its own. It is driven and checked as fully as N=8, so it raises the reachable toggle ceiling instead of hiding gaps. If reviewers want coverage measured at N=8 only, delete the dut32/ref32 instances and the 32-bit expectations. The N=8 toggle ceiling then drops, because of the 26 constant bits listed in the report.

Build risk: Verilator might warn on the N=32 ack_hit comparison, which is always true when wdata[4:0] < 32. If the gate treats that warning as fatal, the build fails and the N=32 instance must be dropped.

Detection-wins and rising-edge behaviour follow the RTL header comments, not a separate specification, since interface_spec.md was not provided to this seat.
